published.title: 做完霍兰德职业兴趣测试怎么选职业？对照两份真实招聘公告
published.excerpt: 同样招数据分析师，公告里写的「设计实验」和「分析指标」分别要怎样查？用一张填好的岗位核对卡，再看访谈和试做怎样改变你的判断。
published.content_md:
**做完霍兰德测试，先从结果里挑一项你想反复做的活动，再找两份同名岗位的招聘公告。** 对照公告里的任务，用一次访谈核实新人会做哪一段，再试做一个小交付物，看看收到反馈后还想不想继续。你要决定的是先探索哪个方向。

同样招「数据分析师」，拼多多校招公告写了设计实验，北京大学大数据分析与应用技术国家工程实验室的公告写了加工、分析指标和撰写研究报告。公告能告诉你用人单位写进了哪些职责和条件。新人多久做一次、能决定什么，需要结合团队实例来核实。文中的公告和北大公开报告可查原文。小林、试做数据、反馈与访谈情景均为教学示例。

## 先填一行岗位核对卡

从公告里抄一条最影响你选择的职责。写下你要问的问题、谁能给出证据，以及什么答案会改变你的下一步。下面用一条真实公告示范，留一行给你填自己的岗位。

| 公告原句（来源与条号） | 要追问的问题 | 要核什么、问谁 | 什么证据会改变下一步 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [拼多多 2027 届数据分析师岗位职责第 3 条](https://career.nankai.edu.cn/correcruit/content/id/116279.html)：「设计实验方案，评估业务策略的效果，提出改进建议」 | 最近一个普通工作月里，有实验吗？若新人参与过，谁定问题和指标？新人负责哪一段？初稿有没有修改？ | 请同团队、同层级的近期入职者举一例，再请熟悉分工的带教核对。记下任务出现的频率、用时、影响的决定，以及新人能提出或决定哪些改动。 | 若新人能在带教下提出分析问题、收到反馈并改一版，先试做业务分析。若新人通常按既定口径出数，另找同层级岗位，看哪里能更早参与问题定义。 |
| _____ | _____ | _____ | _____ |

费马测试编辑部用四个问题读公告。**任务频率**看多久做一次，**时间占比**看占掉多少工作时间，**重要性**看它影响什么决定，**自主权**看本人能选什么问题、方法或改动。每天核对五分钟的报表可能比月度策略评估更频繁，后者却可能影响更重大的决定。这四问用于比较公告。学历、届别、地点和用工条件单独核对。

## 把兴趣结果写成一个能检验的预判

小林是一名准备在上海找第一份工作的统计学本科生。她的霍兰德结果里，研究型（I）靠前。回想课程项目，她最投入的一次是追查报名人数突然下降的原因。她愿意清洗数据、做报表，也愿意先跟着带教练习。她想知道的是，第一份工作有没有机会让她从提出问题走到解释结果，再根据反馈改一版。

她一开始把互联网业务分析排在前面。看到「设计实验」，她猜新人经常能自己追问题，而研究岗大概主要做报告。她给自己定了一个用来排序的条件：如果同层级新人在最近一个普通工作月里，至少有一次机会提出分析问题并跟完一轮反馈，她就先探索这个方向。资深员工讲自己主导过实验，只能帮助她准备下一轮提问。

霍兰德的 RIASEC 框架把职业兴趣组织成六类工作活动偏好。美国国家 O\*NET 开发中心将其 Interest Profiler 用于教育规划与职业探索，手册分别说明这一工具的版本、计分、信度和效度。不同题本的分数按各自说明理解。Hoff 等人综合 105 项研究，估计兴趣与工作环境的契合程度和总体工作满意度有较小的正相关（校正后相关估计 ρ = 0.19，95% 置信区间 0.16–0.21）。这是跨研究的总体关联。小林可以用自己的兴趣结果选择先了解哪种工作活动，再分别核对岗位分工、入职条件和自己能完成的任务。 [O\*NET 手册目录](https://www.onetcenter.org/reports/IP_Manual.html) · [手册全文，第 2、3、5、6 章](https://www.onetcenter.org/dl_files/IP_Manual.pdf) · [Hoff 等，2020](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0001879120301287)

## 两份同名的「数据分析师」公告怎么拆

职业资料描述一类工作的常见活动。招聘公告列出一个用人单位为某个岗位写明的职责和资格。把这两个层次分开，同一个职位名称就能用来找可比对象，而不用拿它猜日常分工。

### 拼多多 2027 届校招数据分析师

南开大学就业服务平台于 **2026 年 9 月 7 日**刊登，工作地点标注为上海。以下五条按公告顺序转述。 [拼多多招聘公告原文](https://career.nankai.edu.cn/correcruit/content/id/116279.html)

| 条目 | 公告写的职责 | 可以怎样追问 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 分析业务数据，帮助各部门发现和解决问题，并支持产品需求优化。 | 收到一个业务需求时，分析师能和对方一起重写问题吗？谁决定分析范围？ |
| 2 | 监测异常波动，做探索性分析并定位问题。 | 上次指标异动时，新人查了哪一段？哪些问题交给了其他同事？ |
| 3 | 设计实验方案，评估业务策略效果并提出改进建议。 | 最近一次实验中，新人先定义指标、在上线后核对效果，还是两段都参与了？ |
| 4 | 整理并分析日常报表，对业务做阶段性总结。 | 报表要多久维护一次？出现异常时，维护者有没有时间追查原因？ |
| 5 | 理解业务背景，识别机会并给出行动建议。 | 建议交给谁？上次建议未被采纳时，分析师收到什么反馈？ |

**投递条件单独记。** 平台的专业要求栏写「不限专业」，详细职位描述则列出计算机、数学、统计学等相关专业、本科及以上学历，以及 SQL、Python 和数理统计等要求。拼多多集团校招官网列出的 2027 届项目毕业时间为 2026 年 9 月至 2027 年 8 月。总入口可以核对届别，具体岗位的专业口径和当前可投状态要向该岗位的招聘渠道确认。 [拼多多集团校招官网](https://careers.pddglobalhr.com/campus)

### 北京大学大数据分析与应用技术国家工程实验室数据分析师

北京大学人事部于 **2026 年 4 月 17 日**发布，**2026 年 5 月 10 日**截止。用人部门是产品工程部，以下四条按公告顺序转述。 [北京大学人事部招聘公告原文](https://hr.pku.edu.cn/rczp/xzjf/ldhtzp/f2a78c086eb544878b1e5a4a5b0799e2.htm)

| 条目 | 公告写的职责 | 可以怎样追问 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 参与建模和改进分析方法，负责数字生态指数等经济管理指标的数据加工、统计和可视化。 | 谁决定采用哪个口径？处理数据的人发现缺失值后，能提出替代方案吗？ |
| 2 | 围绕数字经济、产业发展和 AI 等议题做专题研究，撰写分析报告。 | 选一份近期报告，选题、资料核对、分析和写作分别由谁负责？初入岗的人能参与哪几步？ |
| 3 | 独立或协作制作研究成果展示材料，如演示文稿和数据看板。 | 材料给谁用？初稿通常会因表达问题退回，还是因指标定义退回？ |
| 4 | 承担交办的其他事项。 | 最近有过什么例子？这是经常出现的任务，还是临时安排？ |

**投递条件单独记。** 公告要求硕士及以上学位、相关工作经验和数据分析能力，将相关专业背景及熟悉大模型技术应用列为优先项。招聘范围栏为「校内公开招聘」，备注写明第三方劳务派遣。这个岗位已截止，学历和经验要求也与小林的本科应届路径不同。她用这份公告认识研究任务，再找面向自己层级的实习、项目或入门岗位。

## 从同一句「设计实验」查到两种工作日常

拼多多公告同时列出实验和日常报表。「设计实验」可能意味着团队经常做实验，新人可以在带教下定指标、查分组结果。也可能意味着实验集中在少数项目，资深同事决定方案，新人更多做报表、查异常，到实验阶段按既定口径出数。两种情况都容得下公告第 3 条。要分辨它们，就问一个最近发生的例子，拿到真实分工，再判断它在普通工作周的位置。

**找一个同城、同届的对照。** 南开大学就业服务平台于 **2026 年 11 月 6 日**刊登了上海顽岩私募基金管理有限公司的 2027 届秋招「数据分析师」公告。它写了定位业务问题、建立分析模型和自动化报表、推动分析结论落地，未列设计实验。小林可以顺着报表任务往下问：发现异常的人能不能追查原因，并据此修改报表？公告列出的任务给了她另一个值得比较的入口。若要实际投递，再核岗位状态。作为职业层面的参照，也可以看[商业智能分析相关任务](https://fermatmind.com/zh/career/jobs/business-intelligence-analysts)里的指标定义、质量检查和报表维护，再回到具体公告询问这几项由谁负责。 [上海顽岩秋招公告原文](https://career.nankai.edu.cn/Correcruit/content/id/118211.html)

**找一个看得见的工作成果。** 北大实验室发布的《2025 数字生态指数》在中国指数计算方法中写到，课题组把合作机构的分指数测量指标线性归一化到 10–100，并结合经济统计样本，用线性回归填补部分缺失数据。读到这里，「做指标」变成了具体问题：不同来源的数怎样对齐？哪些来自观测，哪些经过估算？口径变了，下一次怎样复算？公开报告能证明课题组记录了这些方法。受聘者会负责哪一步、花多少时间，仍要问具体团队。拼多多样本在本文能对照的是招聘描述和校招口径，两边掌握的材料不同。 [北大实验室成果介绍](https://bda.pku.edu.cn/info/1088/1167.htm) · [《2025 数字生态指数》，印刷第 11 页／PDF 第 15 页](https://bda.pku.edu.cn/PDF/shuzishengtaizhishu2025baogao.pdf#page=15)

## 用同一份数据试做两种交付物

找一位同伴，用同一份资料分别给你的业务备忘和研究指标卡提意见。两份都留出时间改一版，再记录哪类反馈让你想继续追问，以及你完成任务时用了什么支持。下面用虚构的报名访问数据示范。

| 报名页版本 | 访问设备 | 访问次数 | 完成报名的访问次数 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| 甲 | 手机 | 120 | 12 |
| 甲 | 电脑 | 80 | 18 |
| 乙 | 手机 | 80 | 12 |
| 乙 | 电脑 | 120 | 24 |

### 给产品同事写一页能作决定的备忘

**交付任务：** 回答「现在能不能把所有流量切到乙」，并写出下一轮要查什么。小林初稿用完成报名的访问次数除以总访问次数，算出甲为 30／200（15%），乙为 36／200（18%），建议切换。

**同伴追问：** 手机和电脑在甲、乙的访问占比一样吗？拆开看，手机上甲为 10%、乙为 15%，电脑上甲为 22.5%、乙为 20%。乙的电脑访问占比也更高。合并后乙高 3 个百分点，描述的是这批访问记录。仅凭这张表无法确认差异由页面版本造成，也无法断定各设备上的真实效果方向。

**改完的备忘：** 「先查分流与记录，再决定是否扩大流量。请核对版本按人还是按次分配、同一人重复访问或跨设备时如何记。若能稳定识别同一位访问者，下一轮按人随机分配，保持同一人留在同一组，事先约定观察窗口和设备分组口径，报告按人统计的完成率、分设备结果与不确定性。若目前无法可靠去重，先明确可比较的统计单位。」让同伴读完说一遍下一步，检验这页备忘是否能支持决定。

### 给报告审阅者写一张下个月还能复算的指标卡

**交付任务：** 写清指标、分母、数据版本和缺失规则，让审阅者拿到下一批数据能按同一方法重算。小林初稿写「手机用户报名率 12%，电脑用户报名率 21%」。同伴准备把它写成「每百名手机用户中有 12 人报名」。原表只记访问，同一个人可能出现多次。

**改完的指标卡：** 「按访问次数计算报名完成比例。手机 24／200（12%），电脑 42／200（21%）。分子是该设备上完成报名的访问次数，分母是该设备总访问次数。教学数据 v1 合并了甲、乙两版页面。若下期某设备缺了一个页面版本的记录、缺少分子或分母，或汇总分母为零，将该设备标为‘不可计算’并写下原因。分母有效且确认没有一次访问完成报名时，记为 0%。跨期比较前，核对设备分类与报名事件定义是否一致。」复核时，让同伴复述分母，再问他少一行数据会怎么处理。

两次试做留下两类记录。能复算比例和写清分母，给了小林关于技能的线索。被指出问题后，她还愿意查分流或修改口径，这给了她关于兴趣的线索。她原先以为写报告主要是润色，试过才发现，把分母写对也会影响别人怎么用数据。用不同交付物收到的反馈是这一次的观察，换任务、换协作条件以后还值得再看。

## 访谈回来，按证据调整下一步

拿着开头的核对卡，请一位近期入职的人讲一个普通工作周，再请熟悉分工的带教说说最近一轮项目。可以直接问：「最初的问题是谁提的？你负责哪一步？谁让你改了什么？这在普通一个月里大概出现几次？」回来把回答和原来的预判并排记。团队、层级和项目阶段会改变一个例子能说明什么，遇到不同说法就记下各自的范围。 [西南交通大学《职业人物访谈指导手册》，PDF 第 2–3 页](https://xinli.swjtu.edu.cn/__local/C/2D/D6/A21392BB143617F151264287255_38B06C7B_5547F.pdf#page=2) · [清华大学出版社《职业发展与就业指导》，印刷第 36 页／PDF 第 42 页](https://www.tup.com.cn/upload/books/yz/108641-01.pdf#page=42)

如果能找到实习或带教项目，还可以在真实节奏下试一轮。访谈能说明别人怎样工作，实习或项目能观察你在类似的任务量、支持与反馈下怎样做。 [西南财经大学就业指导中心〈行业实习〉](https://job.swufe.edu.cn/info/1094/3050.htm)

下面三种情景演示小林会怎样调整，访谈并未实际发生。

| 如果接下来核实到 | 小林的下一步 |
| --- | --- |
| 在最近的普通工作月里，同层级新人有过一次从提出业务问题到根据反馈改分析的机会。平时也维护报表，带教会让新人追查自己发现的异常。 | 先探索业务分析，试一次有反馈的异常排查，再核相应的招聘条件。 |
| 新人多在实验结束后按既定口径出数。她在小样里发现自己愿意反复核对指标定义，又找到一个面向当前层级的岗位或带教项目，能让她提出指标修订并跟完一轮反馈。 | 把指标研究提到前面，先探索那个可进入的机会。北大公告用于认识任务。 |
| 只有资深同事介绍自己的项目，或两位受访者说的是不同团队、不同阶段。 | 暂保留两个方向。下一步找同团队、同层级的实例，核实新人参与范围。 |

回到你自己的结果。挑一项你愿意再做一轮的活动，找两份同城或同层级的公告，在核对卡上各填一行。若证据支持其中一项，就约一次访谈或试做。若关键分工仍未知，下一步就是把那个问题问清楚。要记下行动和复盘日期，可以用[费马职业探索工作表](https://fermatmind.com/zh/holland-test/pdf-download)。还想了解分数表达了什么，可以先读[霍兰德结果及其解释边界](https://fermatmind.com/zh/articles/holland-career-interest-test-can-and-cannot-tell-you)。

**资料核对：** 费马测试编辑部，2026 年 11 月 10 日。核对范围为三份公开招聘公告的职位信息与职责、拼多多校招官网的届别说明、北大公开报告的方法段，以及 O\*NET 手册目录和 Hoff 等论文摘要。案例中的候选人、问答和试做用于展示怎么判断，真实团队的日常分工留待读者向当事人核实。

published.title: 双11想买课转行？付款前先核对课程项目和作业反馈
published.excerpt: 用真实 UX 大纲练习核对项目交付和教师点评要求，找出当前班型仍需确认的个人评阅与复评。附八周模拟选课案例和付款前核对单。
published.content_md:
双11想买课转行，先选一项你想练到能独立完成的岗位任务。付款前，问客服要三样材料：**项目任务书、同一份作业的匿名批注样例、当前班型的书面服务说明**。它们分别回答你要交什么、意见会具体到哪一步、付费后有没有人看你的修改稿。

比如你想从运营转到用户体验设计（UX），就把目标缩到一段预约改期流程。你能不能做出可点击的原型，观察使用者在哪一步卡住，再用前后两版作品说明为什么改？下面的核对表用真实课程大纲示范怎么找证据，文末有可以直接发给客服的问句。

## 买课核对表｜用一份真实 UX 大纲填给你看

江苏科技大学的《用户体验与界面设计》是工业设计专业选修课，中国大学 MOOC 将它标为学校专有课程（SPOC）。公开资料列出了项目、评分和按教师点评修改的要求。谁逐份批改、多久回复、二稿是否有人复看，仍需另行确认。这里用公开大纲示范读法。实际授课体验、社会学员报名资格与价格尚未核实。[江苏科技大学课程页](https://www.icourse163.org/spoc/course/JUST-1470993161)

| 核对什么 | 公开大纲可确认 | 仍需确认 | 如果是付费班，怎么核对并决定 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 岗位任务 | 课程包含用户研究、任务分析、原型与用户测试。 | 学员是否要在同一个题目里完整经历这些步骤。 | 看同一个项目的任务书，逐项对应调研、设计、验证。只覆盖其中一环，就按单项技能课比较。 |
| 个人交付物 | 成绩要求列出调研方案、用户画像、线框图、交互原型、视觉稿，以及含用户验证结果的设计报告。 | 每份作业是否个人完成，测试对象由谁找，个人贡献如何记录。 | 要求看提交清单和匿名报告。想练个人作品，就核清自己要完成哪些部分。 |
| 评阅标准与人员 | 设计项目按创新性、实用性、用户中心性、技术实现等因素评价。展示环节有教师和同学提问，作业要求根据教师点评修改。 | 是否逐份批改，谁负责，怎样判断证据和原型质量，多久收到意见。 | 要同一份作业的匿名批注与评分说明。服务里只有答疑或集中讲评时，按实际提供的方式估价。 |
| 修改与复评 | 作业要求明确写了根据教师点评修改与迭代。 | 能否再次提交、是否有人复看、复评次数和截止时间。 | 请卖家书面说明从初稿到复评的时间线。复评是刚需时，等对应班型确认后再付费。 |
| 时间、总价与考核结构 | 公开的总评结构为平时 20%、实验 20%、期末考试 60%。 | 个人每周练习工时、面向社会的报名、价格与服务期限未由该样本证实。 | 对付费班，问清每周课内外工时、额外工具费、作业截止及退费条件。预算和日历都能容纳，再比较价格。 |

**把最影响你决定、又缺书面证据的一项标出来。** 比较两门课时，用同一项岗位任务把表各填一遍。先看哪门课能交出你需要的作品，再比批改和复评，最后核实总费用与每周工时。某项服务会决定你是否买课，就把它填进文末问句，请对方按当前班型书面确认。

## 从招聘要求倒推课程项目

先找两份你愿意申请的同地区、同经验级别岗位，圈出职责里重复出现的动作，例如梳理任务流程、制作可交互原型、组织可用性测试。接着标记哪些你做过，哪些只听过，哪些还拿不出证据。优先补一项你当前最需要、也能在计划时间内练到交付的技能。岗位名称、招录门槛和日常职责要用当下的职位原文核实。 [如何对照两份真实招聘公告选职业](https://fermatmind.com/zh/articles/after-holland-test-compare-job-postings)

例如，招聘信息写“优化关键交互流程”，课程练习可以聚焦在预约改期，让用户把已有预约改到周六，并在新时段确认前保留原预约。要交的成果可以是流程图、可点击原型、测试任务与观察记录，以及修改前后的版本和理由。课程如果只教你照着示例画页面，可以用来补工具操作。想练完整流程，就在大纲里查有没有机会观察用户、解释问题并重新测试。 [费马测试职业档案｜网页与数字界面设计师](https://fermatmind.com/zh/career/jobs/web-and-digital-interface-designers)

## 什么样的作业反馈值得单独付费？

请卖家给你看同一份作业的匿名初稿、批注和修改稿。如果只能看一种材料，优先看批注。具体的批注应说明这份作业的要求、当前的问题和验证修改的办法。

例如，原型展示了预约详情，评阅者发现学员的测试脚本直接说了“点改期按钮”。批注可以指出，这样的指令会提示路径，难以观察用户能否自行找到入口。下一轮把任务改为“你周五来不了，想保留预约并改到周六，请试着完成”，记录参与者第一步点了哪里、遇到什么阻碍、有没有看到新时间的确认。英国政府数字服务手册把明确目标、接近真实情境、避免暗示答案列为设计可用性测试任务的原则。 [英国政府数字服务手册｜主持式可用性测试](https://www.gov.uk/service-manual/user-research/using-moderated-usability-testing)

Hattie 和 Timperley 在教育研究综述中用学习目标、当前进展和下一步三个问题来组织反馈。Butler 等人的两项实验让参与者阅读短文、回答概念题，两天后再测。提供解释的一组在新推理题上表现优于只收到正确答案的一组，两组在重复题上表现相近。对买课者，这些研究提供了一个核问角度，可以查样例是否解释修改理由、是否给学员在新任务里再试的机会。这里的实验结果来自阅读与测验，具体 UX 班的成效需用该班的证据判断。 [Hattie 与 Timperley，2007](https://doi.org/10.3102/003465430298487) · [Butler、Godbole 与 Marsh，2013](https://doi.org/10.1037/a0031026)

群答疑适合处理卡住的软件操作，集中讲评适合看共性问题，同伴互评可以提供其他读者的视角。如果你想知道自己的测试推论能不能成立，就找明确覆盖个人项目、能指出哪条观察支持哪项修改的评阅。**评阅质量和交付承诺分别核实。** 样例里的意见可能很具体，你还要确认自己买的班型包含同样的服务。

## 模拟选课｜八周、900 元预算，先试听还是直接买？

下面的人物、培训班、报价和服务条件均为虚构，用于演示如何决策，与前面的高校课程无关。

小周做门店运营，想尝试初级 UX 岗位。她八周内每周能安排 4 小时，总计 32 小时，预算 900 元。她希望结课时能拿出一份预约改期的项目说明，展示自己如何设计测试任务、做出判断并修改原型。

| 小周核对的条件 | 候选班目前给到的材料 | 小周怎么处理 |
|---|---|---|
| 项目能否练到目标 | 试听页展示预约类流程作业，要求交可点击原型。 | 试听时先做一个改期流程，问清观察记录和修改说明是否列入交付。 |
| 谁看作业、能否复评 | 客服说“导师点评”，只提供群讲评截图，未说明个人批改和复评。 | 要求确认当前班型是否由设计导师逐份批注、是否覆盖测试记录、收到意见的最迟日期，以及二稿有没有一次复评。 |
| 学得完吗 | 课程表标每周约 2 小时上课、1.5 小时练习。 | 八周合计 28 小时，剩 4 小时给测试安排和一次修改。如果试做发现每周练习需 2.5 小时，八周就要 36 小时，现有日历放不下。 |
| 实付多少钱 | 课程 799 元，页面另列本案例所需工具费 99 元。 | 暂计 898 元，只剩 2 元余量。下单前核对工具有无续费、能否导出作品、回放与作业服务何时截止，以及退费书面条件。 |

小周可以先请少量符合情境、同意参与的体验者用虚拟信息试做。在本模拟中，有人把“取消预约”当成了更换日期的入口。她把这条行为记下来，把“更改时间”与“取消预约”分开，改好确认页，再请没看过初稿的人用相近条件完成同一个改期任务。这能帮助她复查具体问题。要判断改动的普遍效果，还需要更多证据。面试作品可以保留任务脚本、去标识观察记录、两版原型和修改理由，方便说明自己如何从观察走到修改。[英国政府数字服务手册｜任务设计与观察](https://www.gov.uk/service-manual/user-research/using-moderated-usability-testing#steps-to-follow)

小周现在可以**先试听**，再按拿到的证据决定。

- 任务书包含原型、测试记录和修改说明，当前班型书面确认个人评阅与复评，试做工时和最终实付均在上限内，可以考虑买。
- 对流程设计本身还有疑问，可以继续试听或先自练。独立做一份小作业，再看自己需要补工具训练、任务设计还是作业评阅。
- 卖家无法确认她需要的评阅服务，或实际总价、每周工时超出上限，就暂缓下单。也可以另找单次作品评阅，核对是否能覆盖她当前缺的环节。

双11下单前，核对实际结算价和预付条件，保存当前班型的宣传页、聊天记录和书面承诺。职业培训还要单独确认服务起止日期、费用明细和退费条件。可参照北京职业技能培训服务合同示范文本列出的项目，并以你所选班型的实际书面条款为核对对象。[双11网络购物消费提示](https://snamr.shaanxi.gov.cn/sy/sjyw/202610/t20261026_3706570.html) · [北京市职业技能培训服务合同示范文本](https://htsfwb.samr.gov.cn/View?id=f0261f5d-8712-4a16-82dc-76258c6e77c7)

## 可复制的付款前核对单

| 项目 | 填写 |
|---|---|
| 目标岗位与想练的一项任务 | 岗位链接：____ ／ 任务：____ |
| 我需要亲手交的作业 | 交付物：____ ／ 对应大纲或任务书：____ |
| 谁按什么标准给意见 | 评阅人角色：____ ／ 是否逐份：____ ／ 批注样例：____ |
| 我有多少时间修改、谁复看 | 出意见时间：____ ／ 重交与复评：____ ／ 截止：____ |
| 总费用与可用时间 | 实付及额外费用：____ ／ 每周课与练习：____ ／ 退费及服务期限：____ |
| 还缺哪项证据、今天怎么决定 | 待核：____ ／ 决定（买／先试听／暂缓）：____ |

可以直接问客服，“我看的是 ___ 班型。请发一个完整项目的任务书、同一份作业的匿名批注样例，并书面确认谁评阅、多久反馈、修改后能否重交复评，以及最终费用和服务截止日期。”

选好课以后，给自己留一道新任务。比如做过“更改预约时间”，再独立尝试“更换门店但保留预约”，记录你能否重新写出测试任务、发现问题并解释修改。这份练习可以显示你会不会把方法用到相近场景，也能帮你找出下一步需要练什么。

published.title: What to Do After a Holland Code Test: Compare Two Real Job Postings
published.excerpt: Cleveland and Colorado both advertised for a Data Analyst. See how the duties differ, use the completed job-posting check, and try the work before picking your next step.
published.content_md:
After a Holland Code test, pick one activity you’d like to do more often. Find two postings with the same job title, compare how each describes that activity, then ask for a recent example or try a small version of the work. Cleveland and Colorado both advertised for a Data Analyst. One posting emphasized city dashboards and open data. The other emphasized statistical analysis for Medicaid. For someone who likes investigating why a number changed, the next step depends on who actually gets to investigate and revise the work.

The postings and public materials are real. Maya, her decisions, the feedback, and the practice data are fictional.

## A job-posting check you can use right away

Copy the blank row and start with one duty. The completed row shows how Maya would investigate a real Cleveland posting. She’s deciding which kind of work to explore first.

| Posting evidence (source and duty) | Question to ask | Evidence to look for and whom to ask | What would change my next step |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [City of Cleveland bulletin 11045-HR](https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/cleveland/jobs/5497374/data-analyst), fifth bullet under *Essential Duties & Job Functions*. “Test data and/or applications to validate data accuracy/quality.” | When a dashboard number is challenged, who traces the discrepancy and who decides whether to revise the measure? | Ask a city analyst or their manager to walk through a recent correction. Look for what the analyst checked, how often this happens, and who signed off. | If analysts at my level regularly investigate discrepancies and propose fixes, explore city reporting first. If they mainly run predefined checks, compare a program-analysis role. If I only have the ad, keep the question open. |
|  |  |  |  |

Use four questions to make the comparison specific. **Task frequency** asks how often the work comes up. **Share of work time** asks how much of a typical week or month it takes. **Importance** asks what depends on getting it right. **Decision authority** asks which parts the analyst can decide and who approves a change. A quarterly quality check can take an hour and still stop a misleading report from going out. A prominent bullet gives you a reason to ask about the duty. The answers need evidence from the team. These four questions are FermatMind Editorial’s method for reading job ads. For occupation-level ratings, O*NET defines its task relevance, frequency, and importance scales separately. [O*NET task scale definitions](https://www.onetonline.org/help/online/scales)

## Turn your Holland Code result into a prediction you can check

Maya remembers a student project where attendance suddenly jumped. She enjoyed tracing the jump to a change in how repeat visits were counted and explaining the correction to the event team. Refreshing the same report after the counting rule was settled held less appeal. Her Holland result points toward investigation and organizing information. Her project narrows that down to a question about the work itself.

She starts with a prediction. **Program evaluation will give me more chances to investigate why a result changed.** She’d reconsider if analysts at her level in evaluation mainly prepare established reports while city analysts get to investigate disputed metrics. A word like *predictive* gives her a lead. A recent assignment can show who posed the question, dealt with ambiguous data, and got to propose a change.

Holland’s six interest areas describe the kinds of work activities people report enjoying. The O*NET Interest Profiler manual explains the forms, scoring, and measurement evidence for that specific assessment. Across 105 studies, Hoff and colleagues estimated a modest positive correlation between interest fit and overall job satisfaction (ρ = 0.19, 95% confidence interval 0.16 to 0.21). That estimate summarizes a group-level association. Maya uses her result to decide which activity to investigate. She assesses her skills, eligibility, and working conditions separately. [O*NET Interest Profiler manual overview](https://www.onetcenter.org/reports/IP_Manual.html) · [Full technical manual, chapters 2, 3, 5, and 6](https://www.onetcenter.org/dl_files/IP_Manual.pdf) · [Hoff et al., 2020](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0001879120301287)

If you’re still figuring out what the letters or scores mean, start with the [guide to what a Holland career interest test can tell you](https://fermatmind.com/en/articles/holland-career-interest-test-can-and-cannot-tell-you).

## How two Data Analyst jobs describe different work

Both vacancies are closed. The first column of each table summarizes advertised duties in source order. The second shows what the work could produce and gives you a way to picture it. Public tools and documents add context about the organization. To learn how much of that work falls to one analyst, ask about an assignment at the same level.

### Cleveland, Ohio — dashboards and open data

Cleveland’s Office of Urban Analytics & Innovation advertised the full-time role from September 28 to October 13, 2026. Its bulletin separates **Examples of Duties** from **Essential Duties & Job Functions**. The first two rows summarize the examples. The next seven follow the essential duties in order. [City of Cleveland job bulletin 11045-HR](https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/cleveland/jobs/5497374/data-analyst)

| Advertised duty | What the work could produce |
| --- | --- |
| Set file specifications and standard field names, advise project leads, and help technical teams implement files | A file specification other teams can follow. |
| Monitor database performance, report improvements, document standards, and support reorganization, recovery, and backups | A performance report or a procedure the technical team can use. Ask who owns recovery and backups. |
| Analyze business or service performance using several data sources | An explanation of a service problem with a proposed action for managers or frontline staff. |
| Work with stakeholders and analysts to deliver lasting solutions | A question the department agrees to solve and a solution teams can maintain. |
| Help departments prepare items for the public Open Data Portal | A public dataset with clear field definitions and metadata. |
| Build dashboards for departmental goals and performance measures | A dashboard managers can use to track progress. |
| Test data or applications for accuracy and quality | A quality check that explains whether a result is ready to use. |
| Track projects from idea to completion | A plan showing requirements, milestones, and outstanding work. |
| Lead status meetings and communicate progress | Updates that help business, technical, and leadership teams coordinate. |

**Qualifications to check separately.** Cleveland listed a relevant bachelor’s degree and two years of database management systems experience. The bulletin describes a substitution of two years of equivalent education, training, or experience for each missing year of college. It also lists Windows and Microsoft Office proficiency, a lifting requirement, and a valid Ohio driver’s license. Power BI, Tableau, or similar software appears among the preferences. [Cleveland bulletin, minimum and preferred qualifications](https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/cleveland/jobs/5497374/data-analyst)

Cleveland’s 311 page links to a service request dashboard and a map explorer. The city’s Data Analytics team describes building tools for city staff and publishing open data. A department could use a tool like this to examine a backlog, while a resident might look up a request. Both audiences need clear definitions. [Cleveland 311](https://www.clevelandohio.gov/311) · [Cleveland Data Analytics](https://www.clevelandohio.gov/city-hall/departments/innovation-technology/uai/data-analytics)

The city’s published inspection outcomes show why data quality can involve judgment. The Cleveland Department of Public Health defines **No Access Available** as an attempt where the inspector couldn’t access the location and **No Code Violation Observed** as an inspection where no violation was observed. Grouping them under “no violation found” would treat an unobserved condition as an inspection result. It’s the kind of distinction Maya wants to investigate. She’d ask whether analysts help settle definitions like these or check them against rules someone else has set. [Cleveland public health inspection outcome definitions](https://www.clevelandohio.gov/city-hall/departments/public-health/submit-complaint)

### Colorado — program analysis and risk assessment support

The Colorado Department of Health Care Policy & Financing advertised a full-time Data Analyst role from September 17 to 28, 2026, under the state classification **Statistical Analyst I**. The posting says analysts may work for any unit and identifies support for the Office of Community Living under an agreement with the federal Department of Justice. Its six advertised duties follow below. [State of Colorado job bulletin UHA 4779 - 9.2026](https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/colorado/jobs/5485852/data-analyst)

| Advertised duty | What the work could produce |
| --- | --- |
| Query and analyze data under supervision, including statistical analysis | A result and an explanation a reviewer can check. |
| Use tools such as Cognos or Toad to query relational databases | An extract with the records and fields a question requires. |
| Write code to prepare data for Colorado Medicaid operations and evaluation questions | An analysis dataset with clear rules about what to include. |
| Prepare reports and communicate findings to internal and external audiences | A report explaining the finding, who it describes, and where the evidence is limited. |
| Support the Office of Community Living and work for other units as needed | Analysis using one program’s definitions with room for assignments elsewhere in the department. |
| Support efforts to prevent long-term facility admissions through predictive analytics and risk assessment | Analytical work that supports the program. Ask whether the role builds models, checks inputs, or works with model outputs. |

**Qualifications to check separately.** Applicants had to be Colorado residents when they applied. The bulletin lists four years of relevant professional experience or the equivalent through related education, relevant experience, or both. A qualifying bachelor’s degree counted for four years under its substitution rules. SQL or R, health-sector data analysis, statistical evaluation, and Tableau appear among the preferences. These terms describe this vacancy, so check the requirements in any new posting you plan to act on. [Colorado bulletin, minimum qualifications and substitutions](https://www.governmentjobs.com/careers/colorado/jobs/5485852/data-analyst)

Colorado’s At-Risk Diversion memo describes how analysis reaches people who can act on it. The department developed a model to help identify some Medicaid members receiving home and community-based services who may need nursing facility care. The memo calls for lists to go to case management agencies. Case managers contact members, record the outreach, and help arrange support. This is evidence about the program’s workflow. Whether the job holder develops the model, checks the inputs, or reports on outreach remains a question for the team. The effect on admissions would require a separate evaluation. [HCPF operational memo OM 25-002](https://hcpf.colorado.gov/sites/hcpf/files/HCPF%20OM%2025-002%20At-Risk%20Diversion%20Process.pdf) · [HCPF’s January 2026 case manager update, an HTML alternative for the outreach workflow](https://myemail.constantcontact.com/Case-Manager-s-Corner--January-2026.html?aid=5h04Mq5DNww&soid=1120776134797)

## Compare the assignments you’d actually want to do

Maya wants to know who gets to investigate a number when it looks wrong. The ads give her two versions of that question.

| What Maya wants to know | Cleveland | Colorado |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Who uses the work?** | The bulletin names city staff and leaders. The city’s public 311 tools also serve residents. | The bulletin names internal and external report audiences. The program memo separately identifies case management agencies as users of the at-risk list. |
| **What might I deliver?** | A dashboard or a public dataset with definitions that other people can follow. | A query, analysis, or report for a specific program question. |
| **What would make this work interesting to me?** | Ask how often analysts get to investigate a disputed measure and suggest a correction. Routine updates and project coordination may take much of the week. | Ask whether an analyst at this level can test competing explanations or mainly prepares data and reports using an established method. |
| **What example would help me decide?** | “Tell me about a recent number someone challenged. What did the analyst check, and who approved the change?” | “What did a Statistical Analyst I produce on a recent assignment, who chose the method, and what changed in review?” |

The two vacancies are in different states and classification systems. For your own shortlist, look for a third posting at a similar level in the same market to see whether the pattern repeats. Occupation profiles can give you more duties to look for, including adjacent work such as maintaining reports and dashboards. Use them for background as you compare individual vacancies. [FermatMind’s Business Intelligence Analysts profile](https://fermatmind.com/en/career/jobs/business-intelligence-analysts) · [O*NET’s Business Intelligence Analysts profile](https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/15-2051.01)

Each source answers a different question. **A job posting records advertised duties and qualifications. An organization’s public work shows an output or workflow. A recent example from the team can clarify who does the work, how much time it takes, and who approves changes. Your own practice sample shows what you did and what you wanted to keep working on.** Keeping those answers separate makes it easier to see what you still need to check.

## Try each kind of work and revise it once

Use the same data, comparable time, and the same tools for both tasks. Save part of the time for revisions. Ask a willing reader to check what they understood and where they’d want more evidence. A practitioner may also tell you which parts resemble their own work. If you’re working alone, use the example objections below and record that you did the check yourself.

The practice data cover fictional community service requests. One group was offered follow-up calls starting in June. Every included request has a status recorded at day 30. The unit is the service request.

| Intake month | Group | Requests tracked | Still open at day 30 |
| --- | --- | ---: | ---: |
| May | Group later offered calls | 40 | 12 |
| May | Comparison group | 50 | 10 |
| June | Group offered calls | 40 | 8 |
| June | Comparison group | 50 | 9 |

### Make a dashboard note an operations lead can use

Sketch a chart for the two intake months. May had **22 of 90 requests still open at day 30 (24.4%)**. June had **17 of 90 (18.9%)**. Label the measure and include the counts. Ask your reader what the chart counts and which figure they would check before sharing it.

In the example, the reader suggests the title “Residents still waiting.” Maya realizes that one resident can submit multiple requests. She changes the title to “Share of service requests still open 30 days after intake,” adds the counts, and makes two checks for the next update. Each request ID should be counted once, and every included request should have reached day 30. Ask your reader to explain the revised chart. If they can identify what was counted and when, the new title resolved the misunderstanding.

### Write an evaluation note a program lead can use

Show the two groups separately. The group offered calls went from **12/40 (30%) to 8/40 (20%)**. The comparison group went from **10/50 (20%) to 9/50 (18%)**. The decline was **8 percentage points larger** in the first group. Ask your reader which sentence would guide a decision about expanding the offer.

In the example, the reader tells Maya that the offer was assigned by service area and asks whether the calls explain the larger decline. Maya revises the note. “The area offered calls had a larger drop in the share of requests still open after 30 days. Before expanding the offer, compare earlier trends and check whether the areas handled different requests or introduced other service changes.” She asks for earlier months by area. The counts show how the groups changed. The data here leave the effect of the calls unresolved.

## How the comparison changes Maya’s next step

Maya expected to prefer program evaluation. During the dashboard revision, she kept wanting to find out how duplicate requests and incomplete follow-up could change the chart. She also enjoyed testing rival explanations in the evaluation note. What mattered to her was getting to follow an uncertain number through to a correction or a defensible conclusion.

She moves a conversation with a city data analyst to the top of her list and asks for a recent disputed metric. If city analysts at the relevant level mainly maintain existing measures and program analysts regularly get to test explanations, she’ll put program evaluation first again. Her next search is for a role that gives her a recurring part in investigating questionable numbers. She’ll check skills and eligibility before treating any vacancy as an option.

## Use the same check on jobs near you

1. **Pick two comparable postings.** Save the employer, location, date, and link. Keep required qualifications and preferences separate from the activities you’re interested in.
2. **Choose one duty and fill in the card.** Note what goes into the task, what it produces, who reviews it, and who uses the result. Use public work to see an example of an output and mark what still needs checking.
3. **Ask about a recent assignment.** “What did you deliver, who reviewed it, and what changed?” If it was an unusual week, ask for a second example. Record whose work it describes and whether the answer changed your prediction. [UC Santa Barbara’s guide to reading job descriptions](https://career.ucsb.edu/discover-options/career-exploration/read-job-descriptions) · [UC Santa Barbara’s guide to informational interviews](https://career.ucsb.edu/discover-options/career-exploration/do-informational-interviews)
4. **Try a small version of the task and revise it.** Record the feedback, what you could do with the tools and support available, and what you’d want to try again. If one exercise used tools you already knew and the other didn’t, record that difference before deciding which felt better.

You can start with an activity you already know you enjoy. If you’d like a starting profile, take the [Holland Code career interest test](https://fermatmind.com/en/tests/holland-career-interest-test-riasec). To keep track of interviews, practice tasks, and when to revisit your choice, use the [career exploration worksheet](https://fermatmind.com/en/holland-test/pdf-download).

*Source check by FermatMind Editorial, November 10, 2026. The two employer bulletins support the duty and qualification comparisons. The Cleveland city pages and the Colorado agency materials describe examples of organizational work. Maya’s decisions and both practice tasks are editorial illustrations.*

published.title: How to Choose an Online Course for a Career Change: Check the Projects and Feedback
published.excerpt: Use a real UX syllabus and a completed checklist to see what you would make, spot gaps in the public review details, and decide what to ask before paying.
published.content_md:
Choose one task you want to be able to do in your next role. **Before you pay, ask for the assignment brief, an anonymized example of comments on one submission, and written terms for the option you would buy.** Check what you will make, who reviews it, and whether anyone will look at the revised version. Then try a small version of the task so you can tell which part you need help with.

## A completed course-buying checklist for a move into UX

Suppose you work in customer support and are exploring user experience (UX) design. You know how to listen to customers and summarize recurring complaints. You want to learn how to run a usability test on an early design, turn what you observe into a design change, and explain why you made it. Assume you have four hours a week for training. Check your research and prototyping experience against the course expectations below before applying the time estimate.

Here is how the **Google UX Design Certificate** looks against that goal. The example focuses on Course 4, *Conduct UX Research and Test Early Concepts*. The entries reflect the public U.S. program and syllabus pages checked November 11, 2026. Use the open questions in the table to check the option you would actually purchase. [Google UX Design Certificate](https://grow.google/certificates/ux-design/) · [Coursera certificate overview](https://www.coursera.org/professional-certificates/google-ux-design) · [Course 4 syllabus](https://www.coursera.org/learn/conduct-ux-research)

| What to check | What the public evidence shows | Decision for this learner |
|---|---|---|
| **Is the task relevant to the role?** | The U.S. O*NET profile for Web and Digital Interface Designers (15-1255.00) lists user research, analysis of user feedback, and fixing problems found during testing among its tasks. [O*NET task list](https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/15-1255.00#Tasks) | These tasks overlap with the skills you want to practice. Compare two current postings you would apply to and check how much each role emphasizes research, visual design, or other duties. |
| **Can I start at Course 4?** | The course page labels it beginner level. The detailed syllabus recommends completing Courses 1–3 first or having comparable experience turning user research into artifacts such as personas and journey maps and creating wireframes and low-fidelity prototypes on paper and in Figma. [Course 4 background expectations](https://www.coursera.org/learn/conduct-ux-research#modules) | Customer support experience can help you listen and synthesize. Check whether you already have the research and prototyping skills this course builds on. If you need the earlier material, recalculate the time and cost before subscribing. |
| **What will I make?** | Module 3 teaches how to synthesize research. Module 4 lists portfolio activities that ask you to plan and run a usability study, turn observations into insights, and update a presentation. It also teaches how to revise a low-fidelity design using those findings. [Course 4, Modules 3 and 4](https://www.coursera.org/learn/conduct-ux-research#modules) | Ask for the assignment brief and rubric. Check whether you must submit the study plan, observation notes, and a rationale for a design change. Find out whether you can retain an anonymized copy of your own work for a portfolio. |
| **Will I observe users myself?** | Module 2 includes a mock study, and Module 4 lists a usability study activity for your own portfolio project. The public outline does not settle participant recruitment or support for the option you buy. [Course 4, Modules 2 and 4](https://www.coursera.org/learn/conduct-ux-research#modules) | Try recruiting two relevant people for a practice session. If recruitment is a constraint, check what the course expects and what support it provides. |
| **Who reviews my work, and can I revise it?** | The syllabus says some assignments are AI-graded. Module 4 lists peer connection under readings; it does not say that peers grade portfolio work. The public page does not identify the portfolio reviewer or establish individual instructor comments or a second review after revision. [Course 4 assessment disclosure and modules](https://www.coursera.org/learn/conduct-ux-research) | If you need expert feedback on your research decisions, ask for an example of that feedback and confirmation of who gives it on the plan you would buy. Treat a second review as unconfirmed until you see it in writing. |
| **Can I fit Course 4 into my schedule?** | The course page gives a headline estimate of about 20 hours. Its four rounded module labels add up to about 14 hours. [Course 4 syllabus](https://www.coursera.org/learn/conduct-ux-research) | With four hours a week, set aside about five weeks using the higher estimate. Allow more time if you need earlier courses, help recruiting participants, or another round of revisions. |

**Check the subscription separately.** Google lists USD $49 per month in the U.S. and Canada after an initial seven-day trial for the certificate subscription. Two charges at that rate would total $98. Check your eligibility, actual price, renewal date, and cancellation and refund terms at checkout. [Google certificate pricing FAQ](https://grow.google/certificates/ux-design/) · [FTC guidance on free trials and auto-renewals](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/getting-and-out-free-trials-auto-renewals-and-negative-option-subscriptions)

**For this example, try the task first.** The public syllabus gives a plausible path to practicing the work. If the practice reveals you mainly need a structured way to plan and synthesize, the course is a candidate once the workload and terms fit. If you need an experienced practitioner to tell you whether your observations justify your redesign, verify that service before paying for it.

## Check the work behind the course title

Start with two current job postings in your target market. Underline the duties that recur and write down one work product each duty would leave behind. For “conduct usability testing,” that could be a study plan, observation notes, and a revised prototype with a short rationale. Then ask which part you could do today and which part you could not yet defend. When a role is still a hypothesis, use a job-posting comparison to decide which skills deserve a trial. [How to compare job postings after a Holland interest test](https://fermatmind.com/en/articles/after-holland-test-compare-job-postings)

Next, compare the assignment instructions with the skill gap. If you can already wireframe a flow but struggle to turn observations into decisions, a guided project with a critique of your findings may help more than a long tool tutorial. If you cannot yet make a prototype someone can try, start there. Keep the comparison fair by putting similar time on each option. Compare what you could make and revise in the first four weeks of each, including practice and review time. For a four-hour weekly budget, compare what a self-paced course and a mentored option each give you in 16 hours. Count time spent recruiting, testing and revising in both. Then check how much you would pay if the work took an extra billing period.

## Find out what “feedback” actually means

Ask **who sees which version of which artifact, what they return, and what you get to do with their comments**.

- **Usability participants** show where people hesitate, make mistakes, or finish a task. Their behavior is evidence about the design under the conditions you tested.
- **Peer review**, if included, means other learners evaluate the work, sometimes against a rubric. A specific observation can help you revise even when reviewers differ in experience.
- **Automated or AI grading**, where disclosed, can check aspects of an assignment. Check what it evaluates and whether someone can help when the result is ambiguous.
- **Individual instructor or mentor critique**, when explicitly included, can examine decisions such as whether your task prompt led participants or whether your design recommendation follows from your notes. Ask who provides it, what qualifies them to review this task, and whether they see the next version.

Educational feedback research supports paying attention to the information you receive. A 2020 meta-analysis found that effects on learning varied substantially and were influenced by the information feedback contained. That finding motivates asking to see an example of the feedback you would receive. Course-specific learning and employment outcomes require their own evidence. [Wisniewski, Zierer and Hattie, *Frontiers in Psychology*](https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2019.03087)

Ask the provider, “Could you share the assignment brief and an anonymized example of comments on one submission? For this plan, can you confirm in writing who reviews my test plan, observation notes, and prototype, when I’ll get comments, and whether someone reviews a revision?”

## Try a small UX project before you pay

**Illustrative example.** A customer-support worker considering UX design sketches an appointment-booking flow for a fictional bike-repair shop. Can a customer choose an evening slot and tell when the appointment is confirmed? Build three screens for time selection, review, and confirmation. Use fictional booking information, label the controls, and check that someone can finish the flow with a keyboard.

Ask participants about their device and any access needs before the session. For this exercise, written notes are enough. If you plan to record, ask permission first. [GOV.UK guidance on planning accessible research sessions](https://www.gov.uk/service-manual/user-research/running-research-sessions-with-people-with-disabilities) · [Digital.gov usability-test script and recording consent](https://digital.gov/resources/how-conduct-usability-test)

1. **Test version one.** Recruit two people who have booked a service online. Give both participants the prompt “Book a brake check after 5 p.m. on Thursday. Tell me when you think the booking is complete.” Avoid pointing to the next control. For each participant, record the first point of hesitation, the screen reached, and whether they correctly identify a confirmed booking without help.
2. **Translate one observation into a revision.** In this hypothetical first round, both participants stop on the review screen and say the appointment is booked, although there is another step. Version one uses “Your appointment” on the review screen and a button labeled “Continue.” In version two, make the status explicit with “Review your appointment,” label the action “Confirm appointment,” and show “Appointment confirmed” only on the final screen. In your notes, connect the wording change to the observed stopping point.
3. **Retest the same task.** With two fresh participants using comparable conditions, repeat the task without cues. Suppose both reach the confirmation screen and correctly say the booking is complete. That gives you a reason to keep testing this change. The two small groups leave open how common the problem is and whether the wording caused the difference. Save the observation, both versions, and the next question you would test. In a separate study, randomly drawn groups of five found between 55% and 99% of the problems identified in the full sample, illustrating how much findings can vary across small groups. [Faulkner’s usability-testing study](https://doi.org/10.3758/BF03195514)

Set aside four hours for this separate trial. Budget 60 minutes for building and recruiting, 40 for testing the first version, 45 for analysis, 45 for revision, and 50 for retesting or scheduling delays. Spread the sessions over the week if you need to. This is a planning example for the trial, not a course estimate.

Use the exercise to choose what help to buy. If you could build both versions but had trouble writing a neutral prompt, look for a course that gives feedback on research plans. If you collected useful observations but could not explain why you chose a revision, look for a review of your analysis. If recruiting and scheduling made the task hard to complete in a normal week, account for that time before choosing a subscription.

## Enroll, try one unit, or hold off

- **Enroll** when the assignment covers your target task, the review arrangement meets your needs, and you can budget time for a revision. Get the total cost and written terms. For a subscription, check when it renews, how to cancel, and what the provider says about refunds. [FTC guidance on choosing a certificate program](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/choosing-vocational-school-or-certificate-program) · [FTC guidance on trials and renewals](https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/getting-and-out-free-trials-auto-renewals-and-negative-option-subscriptions)
- **Try one unit or a comparable exercise** when the syllabus fits but you are unsure about the task, workload, or quality of feedback. If a preview is available, use it to inspect a real assignment. Set a decision date before any verified renewal, and judge the exercise by what you made and revised.
- **Hold off** when the role is still unclear, a prerequisite is missing, or an essential review arrangement remains unverified. If you already have a solid draft and only need someone to critique your reasoning, compare the course against a focused portfolio review using the same budget.

## Copy this checklist before you compare courses

| Question | Your answer and evidence |
|---|---|
| What role am I exploring, and what task appears in two relevant postings? | Role, task, links and dates |
| Which part of the task do I already do, and where do I get stuck? | Prior work and one specific skill gap |
| What will I make, and how will I know whether I can do the task? | Assignment, deliverable and one observable success criterion |
| Who reviews it, what do they review, and can I submit a revision? | Reviewer, example feedback or rubric, turnaround and second review |
| What is the smallest version I can try this week? | Task, time block, resources and evidence to keep |
| What will the complete plan cost, and when do I need to decide? | Time including revision, amount due, charges, renewal and written terms |
| What would make me enroll, try one unit, or hold off? | Decision and the evidence that could change it |
